states.name: modes_off
states.why: Every mode selector at 0 -- the smallest state the reference accepts. Fourteen values, each one demanded by a check that fires on the all-inert state: DT and DT_Out and their factor relation, F_LPFType's 1-or-2, the four corner frequencies, PC_GS_n, the PC_MinPit < PC_MaxPit pair, PC_RefSpd, the two pitch rates and VS_MaxRat.

states.name: modes_on
states.why: Eighteen mode selectors ON at once, so the checks inside their blocks are reachable one at a time. Flp_Mode stays 0: the reference REFUSES IPC_ControlMode and Flp_Mode together, so no single state can hold both, which is why there are three states and not one. avrSWAP(28) is 1 because IPC, PF_Mode and AWC_Mode > 1 each require the extended interface's pitch actuator flag.

states.name: open_loop_flap_fbp
states.why: The three blocks modes_on cannot enter: OL_Mode with Ind_Breakpoint and one non-zero channel index, Flp_Mode with IPC off, and VS_FBP with PC_ControlMode, PRC_Mode and VS_ConstPower off -- the reference rejects each of those pairs. This is the only state that reaches the ALLOCATE and the two AddToList loops.

how_found: scripts/_baseline_probe.py, which calls the TRANSLATION on a state and, with --all-messages, prints every check that fired rather than the last one. Each state took two or three rounds. The translation is not the oracle here and is not taken as one: each state is ALSO a case in the generated corpus, and the corpus is compared against the clean Fortran -- so `the C++ raises nothing on this state` (the probe) and `the Fortran agrees with the C++ on this state` (the harness case) together say the FORTRAN raises nothing on it. Neither artifact says that alone: a harness case on which both sides raise the SAME error passes, so the harness cannot see an inadmissible baseline by itself.
convention: A varied parameter this file does not name takes the INERT value -- 0, 0.0, or a body of zeros at the case's own extent -- exactly as a HELD parameter does. Extents are never inert-filled: they keep the extent the case chose. An array may be given as a full body (a list) or as a sparse map of index -> value over the inert body, which is how avrSWAP names element 28 without carrying 3,000 zeros. R11 REFUSES a name that is not a varied parameter of this unit and a body whose length disagrees with its extent.
